description.narrative: The project will support the Government of Uzbekistan in improving urban wastewater services for the city of Djizzak. Responding directly to the needs of urban communities, it will upgrade and expand the existing sewerage system, provide wastewater treatment services, strengthen institutional capacity, and assist with development of a new provincial water supply and wastewater utility.

description.narrative: Improved and expanded access to reliable, sustainable, and affordable water supply and sanitation services in Djizzak

At least 85,000 urban residents of Djizzak and surrounding areas have access to improved water supply, sewage collection and wastewater treatment facilities by 2021 (baseline 2013: 30,000) Progress/Status: All works contracts were completed. Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:

More than 350 business establishments and more than 110 organizations have access to improved and centralized sewerage system service by 2021 (baseline 2013: 308 business establishments and 105 organizations) Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Wastewater management system in Djizzak city improved Indicator: 300 men and 500 women participated in community-level sanitation and hygiene promotion training by 2017-2018 Progress/Status: The nurses of schools and mahalla specialists serve as facilitator-trainers of sanitation awareness and hygiene promotion, and they disseminate community level project information. More than 1633 people participated in such trainings from mahallas, 915 (56%) of them are women. Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:

Output: Wastewater management system in Djizzak city improved Indicator: Wastewater treatment plant functional, with capacity of 30,000 m3/day by 2021 (baseline 2013: 0 m3/day) Progress/Status: Loan completion period was extended to 31 October 2023.
Ongoing. The treatment plant is under operation. 2 lines (pressure line from Uchtepa (315mm) and 1000 mm line from city connected to STP. 1200 mm line will be connected after FIZ completed the pre treatment works Commissioning work are ongoing
Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:

Of the 241.14 km, expansion of about 102.2 kms has been completed. Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:

Ongoing.
Installation of 3 pumps completed. However, one contract package (Zone C) is still ongoing. Data Source: Provincial statistical data reports Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity of Djizzak Regional Water Supply and Sewerage Enterprise (DWSE) improved Indicator: A customer care unit at the DWSE staffed in 2020, of which 50% are women Progress/Status: Loan closing date was extended to 31 Oct 2023 Ongoing. Customer care / complaints units under provincial Suvokova and its city branch are established and currently staffed with 8 women (40%). It is planned to organize the awareness-raising activities for management of WSS institutions and local branches, on attraction of women to work in WSS institutions and new constructed facilities. Sex-disaggregated complaints database is developed under Suvokova. From January to June 2021 in provincial Suvokova and in Djizzak city branch 19 complaints were recorded, 1 of them being from a woman. Data Source: Executing agency progress reports Baseline value: N Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional capacity of Djizzak Regional Water Supply and Sewerage Enterprise (DWSE) improved Indicator: All technical and financial management staff of the DWSE trained by 2020 Progress/Status: Loan closing date was extended to 31 October 2023.
A grant from the Sanitation Financing Partnership Trust Fund under the Water Financing Partnership Facility will fund a two-month training program for the operations and maintenance (O&M) staff who will operate the wastewater systems (i.e., WWTP, sewers, pump stations) which are under commissioning. Selection of consultant is ongoing; the training will be delivered in Q3‒Q4 2023. It is agreed with the UJSC and Djizzak Suvtaminot that the training will be delivered through the format of lecturing plus hands-on training for the trainees to absorb practical O&M skills. A detailed survey will be conducted to ensure knowledge is captured by the trainees. Data Source: Executing agency progress reports Baseline value: N Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional capacity of Djizzak Regional Water Supply and Sewerage Enterprise (DWSE) improved Indicator: Laboratory of wastewater treatment plant staffed in 2020, of which 50% are women Progress/Status: Loan closing date was extended to 31 Oct 2023.
Ongoing. As of the end of December 2021, 15% of provincial Suvokova and 6,07% of Djizzak city branch staff were females. In the laboratory of the WSS enterprise, 2 women who worked during the launch of the project retained their positions. 1 woman in the accounting department, 1 woman in the personnel department, 2 women as a specialist in working with the population, 2 women in a specialist in dealing with complaints, 2 women as machinists 1 woman a nurse
Data Source: Executing agency progress reports Baseline value: N Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y
